verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs and site clearly document prebuilt, customizable UI components (SignIn/SignUp, UserProfile, OrganizationSwitcher, billing UI) with CSS/branding customization and support for hosted/drop-in flows, matching the story directly (clerk-docs-1, clerk-docs-15, clerk-docs-18, clerk-docs-19, clerk-docs-23, clerk-docs-33, clerk-gh-1). Some community feedback notes reliability/downtime issues but does not concretely contradict the core UI/hosted-page capability, so it doesn't rise to 'disputed'. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of production-scale reliability specifically for the UI components/hosted pages beyond vendor docs.
